name: 24925-4kimage-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=4 req/s, bounded at 1200 requests (~300 s) with a 1200 s safety cap; warmup the first 20% and cooldown the last 10% by completion.
workload: Single-image chat: one 3840x2160 JPEG -- the same picture every request -- plus one short question that varies per row, and 32 output tokens (`ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`). Driven from `configs/data/repeat-4k.jsonl`, 1600 rows, regenerable by `configs/data/make-fixture.py` at seed 24925. Under the declared `max_pixels: 401408` the frame is 480 image tokens and a request is 521 prompt tokens.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant on one GPU, fielding four 4K-photo questions per second with brief replies.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 73cfb3c5eeb8b00a6e222751a28fd89a5f6229dc (`git describe --tags --match 'v*'` =
# v0.10.2rc2-113-g73cfb3c5ee). No released wheel is this tree; configs/env.yaml says where the
# built checkout lives on this machine.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct

# INLINE JSON, not an indented block: the config reader is line-based and skips every line
# starting with a space, so a block-form dict silently never reaches the engine.
mm-processor-kwargs: {"max_pixels": 401408}

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Worst case on the wire is 521 prompt tokens plus 32 output tokens = 553.
max-model-len: 2048
